roll_call: If you have called me, I will examine how human actions, good and bad, resonate with Heaven and Earth.
I will begin the task you entrusted to me by first setting my own heart straight.
I will use ritual and righteousness to make clear the road to good government.
deploy: I will set things right in order, from my own heart to the court, the officials, and the people.
I will place virtue and moral instruction before punishment.
I will apply myself to learning, broaden my understanding, and put the Way into practice.
battle_win: We have upheld what is right; I will not calculate profit or merit.
Ritual, music, and moral instruction have transformed the people's customs.
The good we have done and the virtue we have cultivated have finally borne fruit.
battle_draw: We have not changed the Way; we have only repaired what was obstructed.
Just as yang cannot complete the year alone, virtue also needs support.
A warning remains, calling us to examine and correct ourselves.
battle_lose: I will not blame Heaven for this defeat. Rise and ruin depend on what we do.
I relied on punishment, neglected moral instruction, and allowed resentment to gather. The fault is mine.
I failed to set my own heart straight. I will begin again from the root.
clash_attack: Do not scheme for profit. Uphold what is right.
Do not wield law alone. Advance through virtue and moral instruction.
If standards keep changing, the people will not know what to follow. Let us first establish a clear standard.

roll_call: You called; I will weigh human good and evil before Heaven and Earth.
I will first set my heart straight, then begin the work.
With ritual and righteousness, I will clear the road to good government.
deploy: Order begins in the heart, then reaches court, officials, and people.
Virtue and moral instruction come before punishment.
I will study broadly, deepen understanding, and put the Way into practice.
battle_win: We upheld righteousness. I will count neither profit nor merit.
Ritual, music, and moral instruction have transformed the people's customs.
Good deeds and cultivated virtue have borne fruit at last.
battle_draw: We did not change the Way; we cleared what blocked it.
As yang cannot complete the year alone, virtue also needs support.
The warning remains. We must still examine and correct ourselves.
battle_lose: I will not blame Heaven. Rise and ruin rest on our conduct.
I chose punishment over moral instruction and bred resentment. The fault is mine.
I failed to set my heart straight. I will begin again at the root.
clash_attack: Put virtue and moral instruction before punishment!
Set the law straight, and the people will follow!

roll_call: If you have called me, I will climb through the white clouds to meet you.
If my friend is waiting, I will return when the chrysanthemums bloom.
If you provide the boat, I will cross the great river with you.
deploy: I will move the boat and moor beside the misty islet.
The ferry is crowded, so I will quietly return to Mount Lumen.
The geese are flying south. I too will set my course by thoughts of home.
battle_win: Today, let us open the window, raise a cup, and talk of mulberry and hemp.
The waves rise with enough force to shake the walls of Yueyang.
When the chrysanthemums bloom, I will return and remember this day with you.
battle_draw: I wish to cross, but there is no boat. I will keep looking for a way from the shore.
Day is fading and the ferry is crowded. I will pause and choose my own way.
I ask the way at a bewildering ford, but the evening waters stretch without end.
battle_lose: Lacking talent, I was cast aside; burdened by illness, even friends grew distant.
White hair urges age upon me, and spring presses the old year toward its end.
My ambition wanes with the years, and the evening cicadas only deepen my sorrow.
clash_attack: Though the north wind chills the river, I will return to my home on the bend of the Xiang.
Listen to the birds on every side. Dawn has already come.
Though the rock gate and pine path are silent, I will make my way alone.

roll_call: You called; I will climb through white clouds to meet you.
If my friend waits, I will return when chrysanthemums bloom.
Give me a boat, and I will cross the great river with you.
deploy: I will move the boat and moor beside the misty islet.
The ferry is crowded. I will return to Mount Lumen.
The geese fly south. I follow thoughts of home.
battle_win: Open the window. Raise a cup. Let us speak of mulberry and hemp.
The waves rise high enough to shake Yueyang's walls.
When chrysanthemums bloom, I will return to honor this day.
battle_draw: I would cross, but have no boat. I will search the shore.
Day fades; the ferry is crowded. I will choose my own way.
I ask the way at a forking stream; evening waters stretch without end.
battle_lose: Talent failed me; illness drove even friends away.
White hair hastens age, and spring drives the old year away.
My purpose wanes each year; evening cicadas deepen my sorrow.
clash_attack: Through the north wind, I return to Xiang's bend!
Hear the birds. Dawn has come!
Though the pine path lies silent, I walk alone!
